sourceProfile.shape_origin: declared example; statically inferred, not observed
sourceProfile.drawing_scope: Only the first three squeeze assignments in Block.forward; flow loop and prior are excluded.

sourceFacts: This is a parameter-free bijective rearrangement of 2x2 offsets into channels.
H and W must be even for this selected profile. It is the space-to-channel direction, opposite to PixelShuffle.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
